tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: Page background, the lowest surface (Tailwind bg-surface, CSS --bg-primary). Dark Void matches the native splash and adaptive icon background (app.json:42,97). Surfaces step LIGHTER as they lift in dark and DARKER in light. Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, darkTokens.bgPrimary / lightTokens.bgPrimary.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Panel: lifted chrome. Header bars (AppHeader, TabHeader, BrandHeader), the tab bar, Arena strips (StripShell), modal cards (bg-surface-2, --bg-secondary). Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, darkTokens.bgSecondary / lightTokens.bgSecondary.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: Plate: cards, data plates, toasts, chips, inputs; the Plate primitive (bg-surface-3, --bg-elevated). Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, darkTokens.bgElevated / lightTokens.bgElevated. palette.ts calls this `plate` too.

tokens.name: plate-bright
tokens.usage: Plate Bright: pressed, focused and selected surfaces (active:bg-surface-4), avatar initials ground, the Switch track (bg-surface-4, --bg-elevated-hover). The extreme surface in each theme, so it sets the ink contrast floor. Selected state = this tier plus hairline-strong, never a red fill. Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, darkTokens.bgElevatedHover / lightTokens.bgElevatedHover. NAMING TRAP: palette.ts `panel` is this token.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default text and ALL data values (ELO, ranks, weights, timers), active tab label, primary icons (text-ink, --text-primary). Reads on void, panel, plate, plate-bright. Contrast on void/panel/plate/plate-bright: dark 12.18 to 16.27:1, light 13.27 to 18.32:1 (AA 4.5:1 holds in both themes). Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, darkTokens.textPrimary / lightTokens.textPrimary.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: subtitles, header titles, toast descriptions, MetaTag text, body paragraphs under a title (text-ink-2, --text-secondary). Reads on void, panel, plate, plate-bright. Contrast on void/panel/plate/plate-bright: dark 5.65 to 7.55:1, light 5.23 to 7.22:1 (AA 4.5:1 holds in both themes). Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, darkTokens.textSecondary / lightTokens.textSecondary.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary: metadata, mono caps labels (DataRow and EloTile labels), helper text, inactive tab labels and icons (text-ink-3, --text-tertiary). Labels only, mono 10px and up (palette.ts:28). Reads on void, panel, plate, plate-bright. Contrast on void/panel/plate/plate-bright: dark 4.60 to 6.14:1, light 4.64 to 6.40:1 (AA 4.5:1 holds in both themes). Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, darkTokens.textTertiary / lightTokens.textTertiary (was #6B7280).

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: The label ON a signal-red or signal-red-lift fill: CTA labels, CountPill digits (text-ink-on-cta, --text-on-accent). Void in both themes: 4.60:1 on signal-red, 5.67:1 on signal-red-lift. Never put ink (Terminal White) on the red: that was 3.54:1. Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, darkTokens.textOnAccent / lightTokens.textOnAccent.

tokens.name: signal-red
tokens.usage: Signal Red, THE brand color. Fills and rules only, never text: the one primary CTA fill per surface (bg-cta), the active tab's 2px top edge, Plate accent rail, EloTile 3px bar, CountPill fill, the countdown drain bar, the leader rule (border-l-cta). As a mark it holds 3:1 on every dark ground (3.44 to 4.60:1) and on light void/panel/plate (3.21 to 3.98:1) but FAILS on light plate-bright (2.89:1); kept exact, flagged. Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, darkTokens.accentCta / lightTokens.accentCta.

tokens.name: signal-red-text
tokens.usage: Signal Red tuned for TEXT: red copy where red text is allowed (error copy should prefer `negative`). Tailwind text-cta resolves here (tailwind.config.js theme.extend.textColor.cta), while bg-cta and border-cta stay signal-red. Reads on void, panel, plate, plate-bright. Contrast on void/panel/plate/plate-bright: dark 4.70 to 6.28:1, light 4.62 to 6.37:1 (AA 4.5:1 holds in both themes). Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, darkTokens.accentCtaText / lightTokens.accentCtaText.

tokens.name: signal-red-lift
tokens.usage: Pressed CTA fill (active:bg-cta-hover, palette ctaPressed), the Accept sweep fill. Same in both themes; on-signal reads 5.67:1 on it. As a fill against LIGHT surfaces it is 2.34 to 3.23:1, below 3:1 by design (documented exception, web tokens.css:284-290); dark 4.25 to 5.67:1. Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, darkTokens.accentCtaHover / lightTokens.accentCtaHover.

tokens.name: gain-green
tokens.usage: Gain Green: rating increases, wins and LIVE state ONLY (LivePill, LiveDot, ON AIR tally, Plate live/win rail, positive deltas). Never generic success (ready, confirmed, uploaded). Reads on void, panel, plate, plate-bright. Contrast on void/panel/plate/plate-bright: dark 6.30 to 8.41:1, light 4.64 to 6.41:1 (AA 4.5:1 holds in both themes). Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, darkTokens.statePositive / lightTokens.statePositive (light was #15803D).

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Losses, negative deltas, destructive confirmations, error copy (text-negative, border-negative, Plate loss rail). Same hex as signal-red-text; use this name for loss and error semantics. Reads on void, panel, plate, plate-bright. Contrast on void/panel/plate/plate-bright: dark 4.70 to 6.28:1, light 4.62 to 6.37:1 (AA 4.5:1 holds in both themes). Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, darkTokens.stateNegative / lightTokens.stateNegative.

tokens.name: neutral
tokens.usage: Neutral state (no change, flat delta). Tracks ink-3; no Tailwind class of its own, code uses text-ink-3 (tailwind.config.js cssVarColors). Reads on void, panel, plate, plate-bright. Contrast on void/panel/plate/plate-bright: dark 4.60 to 6.14:1, light 4.64 to 6.40:1 (AA 4.5:1 holds in both themes). Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, darkTokens.stateNeutral / lightTokens.stateNeutral.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Standard 1px border and divider: Plate border, header bottom rule, toast and sheet edges (border-hairline). Always a 1px line in this alpha color, never StyleSheet.hairlineWidth. Decorative separation only: 1.63 to 1.73:1 against the grounds, so never the only signal of state. Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, darkTokens.borderHairline / lightTokens.borderHairline.

tokens.name: hairline-faint
tokens.usage: Faintest divider: row separators inside a plate, skeleton bars (border-hairline-faint, bg-hairline-faint). Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, darkTokens.borderHairlineFaint / lightTokens.borderHairlineFaint.

tokens.name: hairline-strong
tokens.usage: Strongest 1px border: chips, OutlineAction, Avatar, toast frame, secondary buttons, the selected state edge (border-hairline-strong). 1.97 to 2.24:1 against the grounds: below 3:1, so a selected state also needs the plate-bright tier or a glyph. Kept exact, flagged. Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, darkTokens.borderHairlineStrong / lightTokens.borderHairlineStrong.

tokens.name: attention
tokens.usage: Amber, the attention color: draws, pressure score, and pending, processing, paused and disputed states (decided 2026-10-02, 'Open decisions'). Text, icons and borders (text-attention, border-attention, bg-attention; CSS var --attention). Reads on void, panel, plate, plate-bright. Contrast on void/panel/plate/plate-bright: dark 6.68 to 8.93:1, light 4.91 to 6.78:1 (AA 4.5:1 holds in both themes). Light is amber-800 because amber-500 fails 4.5:1 on the light plates. Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, key attention (palette.ts `amber` and useAmber() read it).

tokens.name: attention-rule
tokens.usage: Amber rule or border: the dashed pending StatusPlate edge, the draw EloTile border (border-attention-rule; CSS var --attention-rule). Rules only, never text. Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, key attentionRule (palette.ts `amberRule`).

tokens.name: heat-orange
tokens.usage: Arena heat only: two of the three live embers on the Arena tab icon and the hot start of the challenge afterglow edge (bg-heat-orange; CSS var --heat-orange). Nowhere else (Motion Rule 5). Same in both themes. As a mark: 5.16 to 6.89:1 on dark grounds; FAILS 3:1 on every light ground (1.93 to 2.66:1); kept exact, flagged. Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, key heatOrange (same value as the legacy brandOrange, #F97415); used at components/arena/afterglow-edge.tsx and components/layout/arena-tab-icon.tsx (HEAT_ORANGE).

tokens.name: heat-red
tokens.usage: Arena heat only: the countable embers on the Arena tab icon (one 2.5px ember per pending challenge, 1 to 3, never below 0.35 opacity; bg-heat-red; CSS var --heat-red). Same hex as dark signal-red-text but semantically heat, and fixed in BOTH themes (it does not follow light mode). As a mark: 4.70 to 6.28:1 on dark grounds; FAILS 3:1 on every light ground (2.11 to 2.92:1); kept exact, flagged. Source apps/mobile/lib/tokens.ts, key heatRed (arena-tab-icon.tsx HEAT_EMBER_RED reads it).
